description: Defines the enum LoanTransactionType representing various types of loan transactions in the Fineract project, including methods for type conversion and property checks.

classes.name: LoanTransactionType
classes.description: Enumeration of different loan transaction types with utility methods for type checks and conversions.

methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding LoanTransactionType enum value.
